text:
Self-hosted music that doesn't feel like a chore. One container, zero API keys, and you own every file. 

 
 Website ·
 Docs ·
 FAQ ·
 Discord ·
 Sponsor ·
 Buy me a coffee 
 

 
 
 

- Discover artists you'll like, with a real reason for every pick. Bootstrap straight from your Spotify history.
- Flows turn your taste into scheduled playlists that grab their own tracks and rotate on autopilot. Daily mixes build from what you play.
- Import playlists from Spotify, YouTube Music, Last.fm, ListenBrainz, and M3U files.
- Library managed for you, with real audio verification, automatic tagging, and read-only folder support for music you don't want touched.
- Listen with synced lyrics and radio in the built-in player, from anywhere at music.aurral.org, or in any Subsonic app. Already on Navidrome, Plex, or Jellyfin? Aurral writes M3U playlists and plays nice with all of them.
- Friends see what people on your server and your aurral.org friends are playing, and Blends mix your taste with theirs.
- Share tracks, albums, and playlists as links, publish public playlists, or let friends play straight from your Library.
- Plugins add download sources, imports, and actions when you want them.

Connect slskd, Usenet, qBittorrent, Tidarr, deemix, or download plugins for lossless music, with built-in yt-dlp ready as a fallback out of the box. Every integration is optional. Read the docs for the full tour, or check the FAQ.

 Quick start

 

Run docker compose up -d , open and create your admin account. No companion containers required to start. Want the latest changes early? Use the nightly tag.

 Thanks

Built on MusicBrainz. Chat on Discord, report bugs in Issues.

 Sponsors

 Aurral is free, MIT licensed, and has no paywalled pro tier. Sponsors and coffees pay for the hosted metadata server and keep it that way.

install.title: Quick start
install.html:
services:
  aurral:
    image: ghcr.io/lklynet/aurral:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "3001:3001"
    environment:
      - PUID=1000
      - PGID=1000
    volumes:
      - ./config:/config
      - ./data:/data

Run docker compose up -d, open http://localhost:3001, and create your admin account. No companion containers required to start. Want the latest changes early? Use the nightly tag.
